messages:
Lena F: Flagging an urgent billing defect — nightly invoice generator created duplicate invoice IDs for ~70 customers and, on top of that, added a duplicate "enterprise-support" line to a subset. Some invoices show two line items with identical IDs and amounts.
Omar S: ack. do we have a batch id? Any pattern on affected customers?
Lena F: batch_id=nb-20260402-02. Affected mostly accounts that were part of the Feb->Mar pricing experiment where support tier got renamed to enterprise-support. Looks like the rename + proration code combined weirdly.
billing-bot: Invoice batch nb-20260402-02 finished with warnings=INVOICE_ID_COLLISION,LINEITEM_DUPLICATE count_warn=68
Priya M: sample invoice snippet for acct 54321: `{"invoice_id":"inv-20260402-54321","lines":[{"id":"L100","code":"compute","amount":3400},{"id":"L200","code":"enterprise-support","amount":400},{"id":"L200","code":"enterprise-support","amount":400}]}` — invoice_id appears twice in DB export for one customer and the support line ID duplicated.
Omar S: that sample helps. Two different issues: invoice_id collision (suggests retry logic reused an id) and lineitem duplication (merge step created duplicate). Any recent changes to invoice id generator or to the rename migration?
Lena F: we ran a rolling migration last week to backfill legacy support names -> enterprise-support. migration job ran concurrently with nightly invoicer for a short window. suspect race between migration writes and invoice export.
Priya M: logs from invoice-worker: ```2026-04-02T02:59:58Z invoice-worker INFO start batch nb-20260402-02
2026-04-02T03:00:01Z migration-service INFO rename support->enterprise-support account=54321
2026-04-02T03:00:02Z invoice-worker WARN merge-lineitems: duplicate key L200 for account=54321
2026-04-02T03:00:02Z invoice-worker ERROR invoice-id-gen: collision detected for inv-20260402-54321
2026-04-02T03:00:03Z invoice-worker INFO batch complete with warnings
```
Priya M: the id generator normally uses timestamp+seq but we had a bug where seq reset under high concurrency when migration locks were held, leading to re-use.
Omar S: immediate mitigation I recommend: 1) pause migration job for rename (already paused) 2) pause nightly-invoice-run until we patch idgen 3) write script to detect and mark duplicated invoice_ids in staging export and redact before any outbound emails 4) prepare credit/reissue path.
Lena F: agreed. I've paused migration and stopped cron. Also created ticket BILL-4339 to track root cause and remediation. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-4339
CS-bot: 3 customers opened support tickets about duplicate charges: #T-1209, #T-1210, #T-1211. Notified CS leads.
Priya M: patch PR created: https://github.com/redwood/billing-service/pull/3921 — fixes seq reset in idgen and makes lineitem merge idempotent. Added a safeguard: if duplicate lineitem id detected, treat as single and merge amounts only if different proration windows.
Omar S: let's not re-run full batch until we validate. Plan: run reissue in dry-run for 20 accounts including 54321, verify JSON output, then a targeted reissue for the 68 affected accounts. For any invoices already emailed/paid, create credit notes and issue refunds where necessary. Finance to reconcile expected AR delta.
Lena F: finance note: estimated gross overcharge ~ $28k across accounts; we'll need to generate credit memos and hold cash until reconciled. I'll coordinate with payments team for automated refund or manual ops.
Priya M: added additional logging and a one-time migration to dedupe lineitems at export-time as a stopgap. Will deploy to staging and run tests.
Omar S: once PR merged, I'll kick off dry-run at 2026-04-02T09:00Z then full reissue at 2026-04-02T13:00Z if green. Please keep CS notified.
Lena F: CS template in draft, will send to Priya for final list and amounts. Also flagging legal for large enterprise refunds.
Priya M: test results: dedupe migration prevented duplicate lines in staging. idgen fix prevented reuse on concurrent runs. Ready to merge after one more unit test.
Lena F: thanks. tagging everyone on BILL-4339 checklist: Omar (infra & rerun), Priya (code + tests), Lena (finance + billing ops), CS-bot (customer outreach). Expected closure EOD 2026-04-02.
Omar S: cron stopped, migration paused, s3 snapshot created: s3://redwood-billing/dumps/nb-20260402-02-prepatch.json
Lena F: good work team. Keep thread updated with any escalations.
